note: Rewritten from Chhotani (1997), the original in English; alate, soldier and worker (dimorphic) all available; the original gives the pronotum width of the major worker as '0.45..0.50', with the double dot an OCR defect, and it is therefore not recorded; the wing microsculpture, which involves figure numbers, is also not recorded; synonymy lists, literature citations and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Frontal projection of the soldier distinct, frons steeply sloping anteriorly, fontanelle situated below the frontal projection, fontanelle gland large and elongate to spindle-shaped; mandibles slender and sword-shaped, apex weakly curved inward, left mandible length/head length ratio 0.78–0.98; postmentum arched in lateral view. Alate head capsule yellow to chestnut brown with several pale spots, fontanelle plate elongate, white, situated medially.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellow to straw yellow; antennae and body yellowish white. Head and body with relatively dense hairs. Body length 3.5–4.3 mm. Head capsule rectangular to oval, head length to mandible base 0.80–0.95 mm, maximum width 0.68–0.75 mm; head relatively thick, height 0.45–0.65 mm. Frontal projection distinct; frons steeply sloping anteriorly. Fontanelle distinct, situated below the frontal projection; fontanelle gland large, elongate to spindle-shaped. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 equal to or slightly shorter than segment 2, segment 4 shorter than segment 3. Labrum tongue-shaped, narrowed anteriorly; length 0.10–0.15 mm, width 0.13–0.18 mm. Mandibles slender, sword-shaped, apex weakly curved inward; length 0.70–0.85 mm, shorter than to nearly equal to head length. Postmentum arched in lateral view; length 0.35–0.45 mm, maximum width 0.23–0.25 mm, narrowest at the waist 0.15–0.20 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped, length 0.23–0.25 mm, width 0.40–0.45 mm; anterior margin with a weak notch or without a notch, posterior margin nearly straight.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule pale yellow; antennae, labrum and body yellowish white. Head and body with relatively dense hairs. Body length about 3.0–4.0 mm. Head capsule subquadrate, head length to mandible base 0.70–0.75 mm, maximum width 0.75–0.80 mm. Antennae with 13 or 14 segments. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin with a weak notch; length 0.25–0.35 mm. Minor worker: similar to the major worker but smaller, body length 2.3–2.5 mm, head length to mandible base 0.55–0.60 mm, maximum head width 0.65–0.75 mm, pronotum length 0.25 mm, width 0.40 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule yellow to chestnut brown, with several pale spots; postclypeus light brown; thorax and body slightly paler than the head; legs and body light brown. Head and body with dense hairs. Body length with wings 8.0–10.0 mm, without wings 4.5–6.7 mm. Head capsule round-oval, head length to mandible base 0.65–0.75 mm, width including eyes 0.70–0.80 mm. Fontanelle plate slightly elongate, white, situated medially. Eyes subcircular, maximum diameter 0.20–0.23 mm, close to the antennae, distance between eye and antenna 0.025–0.05 mm. Ocelli oval, maximum diameter 0.075–0.125 mm, close to the eyes, distance between eye and ocellus 0.025–0.038 mm. Antennae 14–15-segmented, mostly 15-segmented; segment 3 shortest, segments 4 and 5 nearly equal in length. Postclypeus raised, hairy, length half its width. Pronotum flat, sub-trapezoidal, length 0.40–0.43 mm, width 0.60–0.70 mm; anterior margin straight or slightly convex, with a weak median notch; posterior margin nearly straight, with a median notch. Wings smoky, margins hairy, membrane with a few hairs; fore wing length 6.7–8.0 mm, hind wing length 6.0–7.0 mm.
